title: 观点、建议与预测
goal: 按依据选择判断的确定程度，并准确表达建议、预测及其条件。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 按把握程度选择观点表达
在建议和预测中正确使用情态动词和条件句

body.p: 观点、建议和预测是三种不同的表达。I think the plan is practical. 表达判断。The team should try it. 提出建议。The team might try it. 只说可能发生。
表达的把握程度要和依据相符。It depends on the cost. 表示结论取决于费用，后面要说明费用怎样影响结论。这些表达没有固定的概率数值。

cards.title: 观点的程度
rows: I think …
提出个人判断，语气不绝对。
I think a shared workspace would be practical.
I'm fairly sure …
把握较大，但留有余地，需要较强的依据。
I'm fairly sure the proposal will pass; most members support it.
It depends on …
说明结论取决于某个条件，再讲条件不同时的判断。
It depends on the rent; a high charge would exclude some groups.
In my view, …
标明这是个人看法。
In my view, access matters more than decoration.
I tend to think …
表达倾向，可以承认例外。
I tend to think smaller groups work better for this task.
I can't be certain, but …
依据不足时使用，but 后面仍要给出内容。
I can't be certain, but the trial may attract new users.

cards.title: 建议的句型
rows: should + 动词原形
提出应采取的行动。
The committee should publish the costs.
could + 动词原形
提出一个可选的方案。
The committee could hold an open meeting.
I'd suggest + 动名词
suggest 后接动名词，不用 suggest to do。
I'd suggest testing the booking system first.
I'd suggest that …
that 从句里的动词用原形。
I'd suggest that the committee test the system first.
If I were …, I'd …
假设自己处在某个位置，提出建议。
If I were the organizer, I'd ask for feedback.
if + 一般现在时
条件可能成真时，主句用 should 或 could 提建议。
If bookings increase, the team could add a session.

cards.title: 预测与条件
rows: will probably + 动词原形
认为很可能发生。
The waiting list will probably grow.
be likely to + 动词原形
表示较可能发生，be 随主语变化。
Extra sessions are likely to attract more visitors.
might + 动词原形
表示有这种可能。
Some visitors might prefer a weekday session.
真实未来条件
if 从句一般用现在时，主句可用 will 或 might。
If the trial succeeds, the team will probably expand it.
假设条件
if + 过去式，主句 would / could + 原形。
If the room were larger, we could admit more visitors.
条件与保证
结论里保留 if 条件。
If funding continues, the service is likely to remain free.

body.box: The student theatre has asked for a larger rehearsal room. Funding has not been approved. A larger room would allow the full cast to rehearse together.

Which prediction preserves the uncertainty?
1. The larger room has already been funded.
2. The cast will certainly receive a larger room.
3. The theatre might get a larger room if funding is approved.
4. The cast cannot rehearse even if a larger room is funded.

body.p: 依据是 Funding has not been approved。第三项用 might 表示可能，用 if 保留资金这一条件。第二项的 will certainly 说得太满。

groups.text: The speaker supports a student shop only if its prices stay affordable. The planned prices are not yet known.

items.stem: Which opening reflects that conditional position?
options: I'm certain the shop will be affordable.
It depends on whether students can afford the prices.
I think the prices have already been approved.
I'm fairly sure every student will shop there.
items.why: 支持的条件是 only if its prices stay affordable。第二项用 It depends on whether 保留了这一条件。

groups.text: Most members have said they support the mentoring plan. A final vote has not yet taken place.

items.stem: Which judgment best matches the evidence without claiming certainty?
options: The vote has already approved the plan.
The plan cannot receive enough support.
I'm fairly sure the plan will be approved.
No member has expressed a view on the plan.
items.why: Most members support 是较强的依据，但 A final vote has not yet taken place。第三项的 fairly sure 有把握，又留有余地。

groups.text: Only one trial has been held, and the speaker is unsure whether evening workshops will attract enough participants.

items.stem: Which opening preserves the limited evidence?
options: I can't be certain, but evening sessions might attract enough people.
I'm certain evening sessions will always attract enough people.
The trial proves that nobody will attend evening sessions.
I'm fairly sure every evening session is already full.
items.why: Only one trial 和 unsure 说明依据有限。第一项用 I can't be certain 和 might 保留了余地。

groups.text: The speaker prefers printed maps but accepts that digital maps work well when the signal is reliable.

items.stem: Which sentence retains both the preference and the exception?
options: I tend to prefer print, and digital maps never work for me.
I prefer digital maps whenever the signal is reliable.
Printed maps are the only kind that ever work well.
I tend to prefer print, though digital maps can work with a good signal.
items.why: 说话人 prefers printed maps，又承认信号好时 digital maps work well。第四项用 tend to prefer 和 though 从句保留了这两点。

groups.text: The workshop coordinator wants a possible action for reducing queues, not a claim about what will happen. Separate sign-in desks are an available option.

options: Separate desks will definitely remove every queue.
The team could use separate desks for sign-in.
The team used separate desks last year.
Separate desks are certain to be installed tomorrow.
items.why: 要的是 a possible action，第二项用 could 提出可选的方案。

groups.text: The speaker imagines being the editor of the student newsletter and recommends shorter announcements.

items.stem: Which sentence gives the intended hypothetical advice?
options: If I am the editor yesterday, I shorten the announcements.
If I were the editor, I will shortened the announcements.
If I were the editor, I'd shorten the announcements.
If I was editing yesterday, I have shorten the announcements.
items.why: imagines being the editor 是假设，用 If I were …, I'd …，would 后接动词原形，即第三项。

groups.text: The reading room will gain another desk only if the storage cabinet is moved. The move remains possible.

options: If the cabinet is moved, the room might gain another desk.
The room has gained a desk because the cabinet stayed.
The room will gain a desk whether or not the cabinet moves.
The cabinet cannot move if another desk is possible.
items.why: only if the storage cabinet is moved 是条件，The move remains possible 支持用 might，即第一项。

groups.text: The coordinator asks for a recommendation about testing the new attendance form before using it widely.

items.stem: Which sentence uses the recommendation frame correctly?
options: I'd suggest to testing the form with one class.
I'd suggest test the form with one class.
I'd suggest to test the form with one class.
I'd suggest testing the form with one class.
items.why: I'd suggest 后接动名词 testing，即第四项。

lines.text: The festival plan seems promising, but I haven't seen its full budget. My support depends on keeping ticket prices low.

items.stem: Which opening accurately expresses the speaker's position?
options: I am certain the festival has an affordable budget.
It depends on whether the ticket prices remain affordable.
The budget proves that ticket prices will be high.
I support the plan regardless of its ticket prices.
items.why: My support depends on keeping ticket prices low 是条件，第二项用 It depends on whether 保留了它。

lines.text: The geology club has enough volunteers for the weekend display, and the room is booked. I'm fairly sure it will go ahead, although the equipment still needs checking.

items.stem: How strong is the speaker's prediction?
options: It is a certainty despite the unchecked equipment.
It says the display has already taken place.
It is confident but leaves room for a remaining problem.
It says the display is impossible despite the booking.
items.why: I'm fairly sure 表示较有把握，although the equipment still needs checking 留下了未解决的问题，即第三项。

lines.text: There may be a better way to distribute lab coats. I'd suggest sorting them by size before the session starts.

options: Arranging the coats by size in advance
Waiting until the session ends to sort coats
Predicting that all coats will have the same size
Reporting that the coats have already been sorted
items.why: 建议是 I'd suggest sorting them by size before the session starts，第一项是这句的同义改写。

lines.text: If more students join the walking group, we might split it into smaller groups. No decision has been made yet.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the conditional prediction?
options: The group has already been divided after a decision.
The group will divide even if membership does not grow.
The group cannot divide when more students join.
A rise in membership could lead to smaller groups.
items.why: If more students join 是条件，might split 表示可能。第四项用 could lead to 保留了这两点。

groups.text: Notes: Attendance at the debate forum has increased each month. Organizers expect the next event to fill, but cancellations remain possible.

items.stem: Which sentence matches that level of confidence?
options: The next event will probably fill, though cancellations are possible.
Every future event will certainly fill without cancellations.
The next event has already filled and cannot lose bookings.
The next event cannot fill because cancellations are possible.
items.why: Organizers expect the next event to fill，但 cancellations remain possible。第一项用 probably 和 though 从句保留了这两点。

groups.text: Notes: Whether an outdoor exhibition is suitable depends on the weather. In dry weather it works well; in heavy rain the artwork needs indoor protection.

items.stem: Which judgment keeps the stated limit?
options: Outdoor exhibitions are suitable in every kind of weather.
It depends on the weather and the protection available.
Heavy rain guarantees that the artwork needs no protection.
Dry weather makes an outdoor exhibition unsuitable.
items.why: 材料说是否合适 depends on the weather，下大雨时 the artwork needs indoor protection。第二项保留了天气和保护这两个条件。

groups.text: The speaker is not the team captain. The speaker imagines that role and recommends giving new players an orientation.

items.stem: Which sentence uses the intended conditional pattern?
options: If I will be captain, I would gave new players an orientation.
If I were captain, I will giving new players an orientation.
If I were captain, I'd give new players an orientation.
If I am captain yesterday, I'd given new players an orientation.
items.why: imagines that role 是假设，用 If I were，I'd 后接原形 give，即第三项。

groups.text: The digital archive may receive funding next term. Expansion is expected if the funding arrives, but it is not guaranteed.

items.stem: Which sentence expresses the intended future condition?
options: If funding arrived last term, expansion has finished.
Expansion is guaranteed even if funding never arrives.
If funding will arrive, expansion probably was complete.
If funding arrives, the archive is likely to expand.
items.why: 资金可能在下学期到位，这是真实的未来条件，if 从句用现在时 arrives。is likely to 表示没有保证，即第四项。
